problem.text: The README heading misspelled the project name as “ExlLlamaV3,” unlike “ExLlamaV3” in its introductory sentence.

reasoning.text: The change removes the extra lowercase “l” from the heading while preserving the embedded image and surrounding text.

impact.text: The README now names the project consistently; the patch changes no executable code.

limitations: Markdown rendering was not tested. No numerical computation or runtime test is useful for this spelling-only change.

claims.text: README.md changes its top-level heading from “ExlLlamaV3” to “ExLlamaV3,” matching the spelling already used in the introduction.

annotation.summary: Corrects the project-name typo in the README heading.
